Even though memory costs are projected to easily become the most expensive component in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not hold true for the iPhone Duo. Here's a comprehensive analysis.

Apple signs three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital posted on Weibo this morning claiming Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and later models," with each panel costing approximately US$250.

The leaker also noted that the panel is "unsurprisingly" one of the most expensive core components of the device.

Although no reliable information on the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo has leaked so far, teardowns breaking down the cost structure of displays, cameras, processors, memory, and other components, along with details Apple has shared about the materials used in the device—including the proportion of recycled materials—offer interesting insights.
